scope: Independent source and behavioral review of atomic fill accounting and startup/reconnect ingestion; no runtime, broker, source edits or live data.

independent_test.isolation: Fresh synthetic SQLite database; denied network and installed-tree writes; denied live credentials/data/brain reads; no model deserialization.

reviewed_contracts: Cumulative quantity and cumulative VWAP produce incremental execution cashflow, rather than incorrectly pricing each partial leg at cumulative average.
Same-order FOR UPDATE precedes fresh persisted summary and execution-watermark reads. Summary, execution, lot/realized-trade and sell-fill audit remain one caller-owned commit.
Duplicate/lower snapshots do not create executions; already committed order summary alone does not suppress repair of missing execution/lot accounting.

Canceled/cancelled/expired terminal partial fills reconcile positive quantity. Unsupported replacement/rejection fill lineage and material equal-quantity cash corrections refuse rather than rewrite history.

Failed lot or audit persistence rolls back complete order; WebSocket failure propagates to bounded queue retry. Reconnect keeps immutable order identities so rollback-expired ORM objects do not prevent processing the next order.
Old terminal state cannot be reopened by equal-quantity nonterminal acknowledgement.

limits.description: SQLite proves transactional rollback/idempotency and the actual ingestion paths, not PostgreSQL concurrent row/advisory lock behavior. Source locks were reviewed; no PostgreSQL server or production database was queried.

Pre-existing reconnect inventory selects at most100 local rows whose updated_at is within a5-minute to1-hour window. An older unchanged accepted order that fills during disconnect may not be selected. Startup polls only the newest500 broker orders. Acceptance does not claim universal missed-fill recovery.
Existing wrong execution/lot cashflow is not automatically rewritten; material same-quantity broker cashflow changes are explicit errors. No historical production state was inspected or repaired.

Out-of-order entry/exit messages can still exhaust bounded retries before an earlier fill arrives; DLQ and finite recovery remain existing mechanisms. Fill timestamp convention and separate portfolio sync were not redesigned.

frozen_impact.basis: Reviewed delta changes broker/accounting ingestion plus lifespan._sync_orders; it does not edit the freeze-declared decision functions, scheduler, provider, feature computation, risk sizing or gates. Author before/after freeze evidence is retained separately in implementation report. No active artifact or forward cutoff changed by reviewer.
